texts: Attendance is one of the strongest parts of the system.
First, the entrance camera recognises each student by face: of twenty-eight students, twenty-five passed the face check and three did not — they did not come to school.
Then the classroom camera counts the room: in the first lesson, twenty-five students are seated.
By the end of the last lesson, only seventeen of twenty-eight remain.
Eleven students are missing from class in total, and the system counts it automatically.
